title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-ended tool agents can complete the same objective through different tool paths, and their quality depends jointly on the interaction trace, environment state, and final artifacts, so such tasks rarely admit an executable ground-truth reward. The central challenge is therefore to construct a reward from existing experience that exposes the current policy's failures while remaining stationary during optimization. We introduce Reward Engine, which, like a self-motivated student, first works out what success requires and then optimizes toward it. From the task and initial trajectories, it builds a RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, each executed as a check that returns a judgment with evidence. The frozen RewardPack then guides the agent to revise and select its outputs, and can also serve as a reward for reinforcement learning. translated_title: 奖励引擎：面向开放式工具代理的以奖励为中心的自进化
translated_abstract: 开放式工具代理可以通过不同的工具路径完成同一目标，其质量取决于交互轨迹、环境状态和最终产物的共同表现，因此这类任务很少有可执行的真值奖励可用。因此，核心挑战在于如何从已有经验中构建一个奖励，既能暴露当前策略的失败之处，又能在优化过程中保持稳定。我们提出了奖励引擎，它就像一个自我驱动的学生，先弄清楚成功需要什么，然后朝着这个目标进行优化。它从任务和初始轨迹出发，构建一个RewardPack，其中包含用于验证所需正确性的测试用例和用于分级评估质量的评分标准，每一项都作为检查执行，并返回带有证据的判断。冻结的RewardPack随后引导代理修改和筛选其输出，还可以作为强化学习的奖励信号。在WorkBuddy Bench Office和Claw-Eval基准上，所构建的奖励（摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 提出Reward Engine，通过从任务和初始轨迹中构建包含测试用例与评分标准的冻结RewardPack，为缺乏可执行真值奖励的开放式工具代理任务提供稳定的奖励信号，引导代理自我修正并支持强化学习优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Reward Engine, which constructs a frozen RewardPack of testcases and rubrics from tasks and initial trajectories to provide a stationary reward signal for open-ended tool agent tasks lacking executable ground-truth rewards, guiding agents to self-revise their outputs and enabling reinforcement learning.
